wiki_text: Golar's Hilli Episeyo FLNG vessel completed its LNG production contract offshore Cameroon (Kribi) in July 2026 and departed for Singapore, where Seatrium is performing life-extension and winterisation works ahead of a 20-year charter redeployment to Argentina LNG. Both sources place the vessel's arrival and startup at the Rio Negro/San Matias Gulf site in 2027, consistent with GEM's existing OriginalPlannedStartYear/LatestPlannedStartYear values for this unit.
